tasks.name: Project Scaffold
tasks.description: Create all project config files — package.json with React 19 + Framer Motion 12 + Vite 6 + Tailwind 3.4 dependencies, TypeScript strict config, Vite plugin, Tailwind with custom pastel colors, PostCSS, index.html with Google Fonts (Playfair Display + Inter), main.tsx entry point, index.css with Tailwind imports

tasks.name: Content Configuration
tasks.description: Central content file — UNLOCK_DATE (2025-09-03), herName, heroSubtitle, reasonsILoveYou (4 cards), photos (4 with src/caption/message), timeline (6 entries with icon/title/date/description/photo)

steps.description: Create src/config/content.ts with all text, dates, and asset paths

tasks.name: Floating Elements Component
tasks.description: FloatingElements component with 3 sub-components — FloatingHeart (y-axis float + rotation), FloatingSparkle (scale pulse), FloatingCloud (x-axis drift). 6 hearts, 5 sparkles, 3 clouds with staggered delays. Toggle via hearts/sparkles/clouds props

steps.description: Create src/components/FloatingElements.tsx with FloatingHeart, FloatingSparkle, FloatingCloud

tasks.name: Lock Screen Component
tasks.description: LockScreen with countdown timer (days/hours/minutes/seconds), glassmorphism card, 'Something special is coming...' pulsing text. Checks every second — when timer hits 0, fades out after 1.5s and calls onUnlock callback. Uses FloatingElements with hearts

steps.description: Create src/components/LockScreen.tsx with countdown timer and unlock transition

tasks.name: Hero Component
tasks.description: Hero section with staggered letter animation for 'Happy Birthday, [name]', subtitle fade-in, FloatingElements (hearts + sparkles), and bouncing scroll indicator arrow at bottom

steps.description: Create src/components/Hero.tsx with staggered text animation and scroll indicator

tasks.name: Why You're Special Component
tasks.description: TextCard component (scroll fade-in, title scale, heart reveal) + WhyYoureSpecial section rendering 4 cards from config with staggered delays. Lavender gradient background

tasks.name: Photo Gallery Component
tasks.description: PhotoCard with polaroid-style white frame, hover tilt + scale animation, click to zoom overlay with sweet message. PhotoGallery renders 4 cards in flex-wrap layout with FloatingElements clouds in background

steps.description: Create src/components/PhotoCard.tsx with polaroid frames and zoom overlay

tasks.name: Timeline Component
tasks.description: Horizontal timeline with 6 icon landmarks (💕☕🏠⚽📚📖), connecting line, scroll fade-in. Click any icon → TimelineCard slides up from bottom with photo, date, title, description. Spring animation on card reveal

steps.description: Create src/components/Timeline.tsx with icon landmarks and connecting line

tasks.name: App Composition + Final Assembly
tasks.description: App.tsx composes LockScreen → Hero → WhyYoureSpecial → PhotoGallery → Timeline. LockScreen blocks content until unlock date, then fades in all sections with AnimatePresence. Includes dev server verify, npm run build, final commit

steps.description: Create src/App.tsx composing all sections with lock screen
Run npm run dev and verify everything works
Run npm run build and verify production bundle
